summary: A B2B site structured around private-label enquiries rather than retail browsing.
challenge: Before TDM, the brand needed a professional B2B website to present its private labeling and perfume manufacturing services and attract potential business clients.
approach: TDM created a sleek, service-focused website with clear navigation, professional design, and lead-generation structure. The platform highlighted their manufacturing capabilities, improved credibility, and made it easier for businesses to inquire about private labeling services.
